Try asking Grok @Bot to make calls!

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Sawyer Merritt (@SawyerMerritt); megjelent: 2026-11-03T19:17:42+00:00; link: https://x.com/SawyerMerritt/status/2117697749009207386; média: videó, 95 másodperc]
Grok @Bot's new calling feature is very impressive.

You just tell it who to call and why, and it handles the conversation for you. It shows a real-time transcript of the call, and if Grok needs additional info from you, a little answer box pops up where you type/select your response, and Grok relays it to the person on the phone. Pretty incredible.
